questions.prompt: According to the periodization table of medieval Europe, the Early Middle Ages came to an end in which year?
questions.explanation: Recall the three medieval periods: The chapter table divides the Middle Ages into three blocks: Early Middle Ages (476-1000 C.E.), High Middle Ages (1000-1300 C.E.) and Late Middle Ages (1300-1450 C.E.). Test each option against the table: Option A (476 C.E.) is the year the Early Middle Ages began, not ended. Option C (1300 C.E.) is the close of the High Middle Ages. Option D (1450 C.E.) is the close of the Late Middle Ages. Read off the correct boundary: The table marks the Early Middle Ages as '476-1000 C.E.', so the period ended in 1000 C.E., when the High Middle Ages opened. The correct choice is B.
